## Summary

Declare Workflow

## Claim

### Formal Claim

```CFEL
# model
Atom/(.Header.Role: Operations)/Workflow;

Atom/(.Header.Role: Operations)/Workflow >| (Container == yes);

# instances
Workflow//$workflow{::1+}((CONTAINS)) Step//$step;

Workflow//$workflow_2{::0+}((IS_RUN_BY)) Step//$step_2;

Workflow//$definition {::0+}((HAS_EXECUTION)) Workflow Run//$run
```

## Semantics

A Workflow defines a graph of Steps for governed work. Its Purpose distinguishes Runtime Workflows from Project Workflows through the selections `Workflow/(.Purpose := Runtime)` and `Workflow/(.Purpose := Project)`.

Both selections inherit the same Step and Action definitions, graph rules, bindings and execution model. Steps and Actions can be reused by either selection. Purpose concerns use in a Project; reusable Workflow definitions can serve different Project-relative purposes without copying their canonical definition. Purpose does not determine shared or isolated execution context, definition ownership or delivery location.

## Summary

Declare Step

## Claim

### Formal Claim

```CFEL
# model
Atom/(.Header.Role: Operations)/Step;

Atom/(.Header.Role: Operations)/Step >| (Container == yes);

# instances
Step//$step;

$step{::1}((IS_CONTAINED_BY)) (in (Workflow, Step))//$parent;

IF $step {=0}((RUNS)) THEN $step {::1+}((CONTAINS)) Step//$nested_step;

IF $step {>0}((RUNS)) THEN $step {::0}((CONTAINS));

IF $step {=0}((CONTAINS)) THEN $step {::1}((RUNS)) (in (Action, Workflow))//$selected;

Step//$definition {::0+}((HAS_EXECUTION)) Step Run//$run
```

## Semantics

A Step is a unit of work within a Workflow. It either runs exactly one Action or Workflow, or contains one or more Steps.

## Summary

Declare Runtime Workflow

## Claim

### Formal Claim

```CFEL
Atom/(.Header.Role: Operations)/Workflow/(.Purpose := Runtime)
```

## Semantics

A Runtime Workflow is a Workflow whose Purpose is Runtime: it provides behavior through a Project's delivered result during its operation. In CAPRMEDIO, examples include Create Draft, Promote Draft and Archive Atom.

It inherits Workflow's shared Step and Action model. Purpose describes use relative to a Project and does not change the canonical definition's owning Scope Unit.
